name: Cafe Fooca

location.address: No. 79 Maryam-e Sharghi St, off Fereshteh St, Elahiyeh, Tehran

description: A neighborhood cafe-bakery that acts like a tiny patisserie: fresh croissants, home cakes and day pastries baked on-site, with espresso, Turkish and brewed coffee. Small courtyard for sunny mornings. Modest, warm and local; not a laptop camp. Go early. Open 7:00-22:00.
